queries.sql: SELECT a."id", a."email", p_posts_sub_lat."value" AS "posts" FROM "account" a LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(p_posts_sub)) AS "value" FROM (SELECT p."id", p."title" FROM "post" p WHERE p."author" = a."id") p_posts_sub) p_posts_sub_lat ON true WHERE a."id" >= $1 AND a."id" < $2
